description: Look up BornThen demographic figures (population, life expectancy, child mortality, literacy, urbanisation, each labelled statistic / estimate / model) and sourced historical events (wars, famines, plagues, depressions) by year, period slug (e.g. "1920s", "14th-century"), place, or event keyword.

event_query.description: Keyword or event id to search historical events (e.g. "black death", "great depression", "famine").

period_slug.description: Decade or century slug such as "1920s", "1840s", "14th-century", or "1st-century".

place.description: ISO3 country code (e.g. "GBR", "CHN", "IND") or historical region id (e.g. "mesopotamia", "north-china", "western-europe").

name: query_era_facts
title: Query historical era demographics and events
